description:
Summary metrics about containers running on Kubernetes nodes.

Dashboard was taken from here.  This version does not reqiure you to
setup the Kubernetes-app plugin. (https://github.com/grafana/kubernetes-app)

Use this Helm chart to launch Grafana into a Kubernetes cluster.  It will include this dashboard and many more dashboards to give you visibility into the Kubernetes Cluster. (https://github.com/sekka1/cloud-public/tree/master/kubernetes/pods/grafana-helm)

panels.title: Cluster Pod Usage
panels.description: Running pod usage against cluster-wide allocatable pod capacity. Kubernetes pod phase metrics in this cluster do not expose a node label, so this panel is cluster-wide.

targets.expr: (sum(max by (instance,device) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} and on (instance) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})) - sum(max by (instance,device) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} and on (instance) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}))) / sum(max by (instance,device) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} and on (instance) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Cluster Disk Usage
panels.description: Disk usage from node-exporter filesystem byte metrics. Bind mounts are deduplicated by device; tmpfs and overlay filesystems are excluded. The node selector is joined through node_uname_info.

panels.title: Cluster Pod Capacity
panels.description: Cluster pod capacity and running pod count. Pod phase metrics are cluster-wide because this cluster’s kube-state-metrics does not attach a node label to them.

targets.expr: sum(max by (instance,device) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} and on (instance) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})) - sum(max by (instance,device) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} and on (instance) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Containers Restarts (Last 30 Minutes)
panels.description: Rounded count of container restarts across the selected namespace over the last 30 minutes.
